name: codex-agents-workflow
description: Host-compiled Workflow authoring, portable packages, versioned Runs and pinned Provider execution.

interface.shortDescription: Build and run versioned Workflows with pinned Providers and main-agent acceptance.
interface.longDescription: Codex Agents Workflow keeps the main agent responsible for requirements, verification and acceptance. Its built-in skill2workflow and build_workflow authoring Workflows ask models only for a compact semantic plan; the Host deterministically compiles graph IDs, bindings, schemas, execution fields and package metadata. One optional semantic delta repair is allowed, while mechanical failures stop without model retry. You own a versioned Workflow graph with pinned Providers, Skill policies, resources, permissions and final acceptance. Content-addressed Workflow packages can be exported and installed from local JSON or HTTPS with compatibility, resource and dependency validation. New Workflows use Cooperative execution by default. A durable Run journal persists exact task identities, fences stale leases and supports exact recovery without automatic resubmission.
defaultPrompt: Use $codex-agents-workflow:workflow-control-plane only for matched execution; never planning, comparison, audit, or experiments.
Keep external Providers off unless explicitly enabled and bound to the selected Workflow.
